subject: Acme Fintech — Procurement next steps & stakeholder mapping
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Tracy Nguyen <tracy.nguyen@acme-fintech.com>, Martin Cole <martin.cole@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Fintech — Procurement next steps & stakeholder mapping

Hi Tracy + Martin —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the procurement path: 

Call recap (high level):
- Goal: pilot Redwood inference on a subset of customer-facing workflows to reduce latency/cost and improve response consistency.
- Primary success metrics: 95th pct latency < 300ms, per-call cost target ~ $0.02/token equivalent for production usage, and SLA expectations for availability.

Open items we discussed (asks from your side):
1) Stakeholder mapping: who is the economic buyer (name/title)? who owns security/legal review? who will sign the PO?
2) Procurement requirements: preferred PO format, invoicing cadence (net-30/45), legal redlines, and tax/W-9 details.
3) Vendor onboarding: any vendor risk/security questionnaire or evidence (SOC2, data processing agreement) we should complete and where to upload it.
4) Timeline: target decision date and preferred go-live window for the pilot.

Attached: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (pilot scope + pricing) and PO_Template.xlsx. Also attaching our W9 for finance.

Proposed next steps:
- Marissa (me) will provide SOC2 and vendor questionnaire answers and a link to our security packet (see link below).
- Suggest a short 30-min call this week with your procurement + security to go over onboarding checklist — happy to include Dev Patel from our legal/security team for any technical security questions.
- Please confirm the economic buyer and the billing contact (email) so we can prep the PO and invoicing.

If you can reply with the names/emails and any immediate docs we should complete, I’ll get everything over before EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0147

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from our side and a few asks so your team can prepare: 

Stakeholder mapping (who’s involved):
- Martin Cole, CTO — economic buyer for platform purchases (final sign-off).
- Me (Tracy Nguyen), Head of Ops — will coordinate onboarding and run the vendor evaluation.
- Procurement (procurement@acme-fintech.com) — handles PO issuance and invoice routing.
- Security/Legal: Erica Ramos (security@acme-fintech.com) — will need SOC2 report + completed vendor questionnaire.

Procurement/finance asks:
- We typically run Net-30. Please confirm you can invoice to finance@acme-fintech.com and include our PO number when issued.
- Need W-9 and company tax details (upload to our vendor portal).
- If there are any non-standard legal terms, please flag now so we can scope with legal.

Vendor onboarding docs we need from you:
- SOC2 Type II (or SOC2 Type II attestation) — can be uploaded to <https://vendors.acme-fintech.com/upload>.
- Completed vendor questionnaire (we’ll send the form, but if you have a standard vendor security packet/link that speeds this up please share).

Timeline: procurement aims to have a PO issued by 2026-03-12 if the security review is straightforward. If that works, please confirm and we’ll lock in the dates.

Cc’ing procurement and Martin to keep them in the loop.

Thanks,
Tracy
Head of Operations | Acme Fintech
tracy.nguyen@acme-fintech.com
